notes: YOK-158 calibration bot (Sparring Partner rec 4 of YOK-154; R5, Y4). Not a default anywhere: it plays only through --bot data/harness/newcomer-kihon-bot-calibration.json. It is the newcomer bot (newcomer-kihon-bot.json) with exactly two fight values changed: block_pct 100 (guard up for every threat it sees) and mistake_pct 0 (never a random normal); idle_guard_pct stays at the newcomer's 50 (YOK-155) and every other value is the newcomer's. One batch (seed 1, 200 runs) asks whether any version of this bot reaches Y4 pace (about 4.5:1 unblocked hits landed to taken, decision 2026-10-21) against this AI; if not, the AI model is the problem, not the newcomer settings.
